title: Inside our 6-stage screening process
excerpt: How we narrow hundreds of CVs down to a shortlist you'll actually want to interview.
body: Every hiring manager knows the pain of a bloated shortlist. Our six-stage process exists to make sure the profiles you see have already been measured against the role.
It starts with a need-analysis call where we learn the role, the team and what success looks like after six months. From there we source across our database, referrals and targeted outreach.

Each candidate is evaluated for skills and fit, then presented with a short recruiter note. We run background and reference checks before an offer, and we stay involved through negotiation and joining.
The result: fewer interviews, faster decisions and better retention.

title: 7 resume fixes that get more interview calls
excerpt: Small, practical changes our recruiters wish every candidate made.
body: Lead with impact: replace duties with outcomes and numbers wherever you can.
Tailor the top third of your resume to the role you are applying for, including the skills listed in the job description.
Keep it to one or two pages, use a clean layout and save it as a PDF.
Add links to your portfolio, GitHub or LinkedIn, and make sure they are up to date.
Finally, proofread. A single typo can undo a great first impression.

title: Contract vs permanent staffing: which fits your team?
excerpt: A quick guide to choosing the right hiring model for projects, peaks and long-term growth.
body: Contract staffing gives you speed and flexibility: ideal for projects, seasonal peaks or roles you are still validating.
Permanent hiring builds long-term capability and culture, and is the right choice for core roles.
Many of our clients use contract-to-hire, which lets both sides evaluate fit before committing.
Talk to us about your roadmap and we will recommend a mix that balances cost, speed and continuity.
